title: Map (scale a control)
description: Rescales a control: from one range to another, turned around, limited, smoothed and given a unit (so a general control can steer a parameter in Hz or dB).

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off makes a control that stays at the low end of the range.

parameters.name: in_low
parameters.doc: The value of the incoming control that becomes out_low (in its own unit; a general control runs from 0 to 1).

parameters.name: in_high
parameters.doc: The value of the incoming control that becomes out_high.

parameters.name: out_low
parameters.doc: The low end of the result, in the unit chosen below.

parameters.name: out_high
parameters.doc: The high end of the result.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.doc: The unit of the control this block makes. none: a general control (a level from 0 to 1) that is scaled to the range of the parameter it steers. Hz, dB, ...: a typed control that only steers a parameter in that unit; the range is then written in that unit.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.doc: On turns the result around (a car passing closes a filter instead of opening it).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.doc: On keeps the result between out_low and out_high.

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.doc: Smooths the result: a longer time makes slower, softer moves.
